notes: Unique name and one hopeful line per keeper statue and Journal trophy from content/dojo/decorations.json (#131). Ids unchanged. 'Floor Keeper Statue' and 'Journal Friend Trophy' can stay as group names. Each line is one sentence under 80 characters, ages 6-9.

decorations.name: Brave Lion-Dog Statue
decorations.description: This lion-dog guarded the Lantern Halls and cheers when you are brave.

decorations.name: Patient Turtle Statue
decorations.description: Slow and steady, this turtle waited for light and reminds you to be patient.

decorations.name: Peaceful Crane Statue
decorations.description: This crane stands tall and calm, showing you how to move with grace.

decorations.name: Speedy Swarmer Trophy
decorations.description: The quick little Swarmer zips happily now that the shadow is gone.

decorations.name: Shield Guard Trophy
decorations.description: The Shield Guard now holds its shield up to keep its friends safe.

decorations.name: Gentle Brute Trophy
decorations.description: The big, strong Brute is a gentle helper now, waving from its stand.

decorations.name: Kind Keeper Trophy
decorations.description: The Floor Keeper is free again and keeps a warm light glowing for you.

decorations.name: Bouncy Bopper Trophy
decorations.description: Bopper bounces in the light again, foam staff held up high.
